📖 Kate's New Phone 📱

Прочитай вслух 2 раза 👅 · потом ответь — да или нет (нажми на строку — появятся ✓ или ✗)
Kate is ten. She has got a new phone from Dad. 📱
The phone is blue. It is new and nice!
Why is Kate happy? — Because she can phone Granny!
Granny lives in London. Kate phones her every day! 📞
At home baby Sam cries. 😢 Why? — Because he wants the phone!
No, Sam! You sleep now. The new phone is Kate's!
Now they are happy. The family is happy. 😊
YIs Kate nine?
YIs the phone blue?
YDoes Sam want the phone?

А теперь — вопросики! 🎤 Подумай и нажми:

Why is Kate happy? — Because she can phone Granny!
Why does Sam cry? — Because he wants the phone!
What colour is the phone? — Blue!
How old is Kate? — Ten!
What's the matter with Sam? — He wants the phone! 😢

✍️ Раскрой скобки — теперь ТЕКСТ! ⭐ 0 / 8

Напиши глагол правильно — прямо в окошке в тексте!
Правила-помощник — памятка 📖
🎵 «it, he, she — глагол с s-кой напиши!»
обычно → +s (likes) · sh, ch, x, o, s → +es (watches, goes) · согласная + y → ies (cry → cries)
I · we · they и множественное число → без s! (I go, my legs hurt) · ⭐ звёздный глагол: have → has
My friend Nina (go) to the gym every day. She (like) gymnastics! 🤸‍♀️ Nina (have) a new rope. Her cat (watch) the rope — cats (like) new toys! I (go) to the gym too. We (watch) Nina. The baby (cry) — he wants the rope! My legs (hurt)! 🦵
